verdict.rationale: Runloop's core offering is Devboxes—isolated Linux sandboxes explicitly designed to run AI-agent-generated code without touching user infrastructure, with supporting isolation features like network egress policies, encrypted secrets, SSH access, and execute/run APIs. Extensive first-party docs cover the full lifecycle (create, execute, snapshot, suspend/resume, tunnel) reinforcing safe untrusted-code execution. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of isolation/security guarantees and any incident-based evidence of sandbox escape resistance.
